item.name: POST /posts — Missing required field 'title' (400 Bad Request)

exec: // WHY: NEGATIVE TEST — APIs should reject requests missing required fields.

// In a real API, we expect 400 Bad Request here.

// JSONPlaceholder does not enforce validation — documenting expected vs actual
console.warn('DEFECT: API accepted request with missing required field title');

request.description: WHY: NEGATIVE TEST — Missing required field. Expect 400 Bad Request. Documents the API's current (lenient) behavior as a known defect.
